The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.74 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the risk weighting to improve the judge_reward.
